audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: The WSG movement/fall-chain fold, the third seam round after gap closure: no new book pages, the R499 pattern applied to the climbing-and-falling chapter. One falling character flows through seven landed headers: the climbing ratings (rules/wsgclimb.h R435: the 40 percent non-thief, the 80 percent mountaineer, the fall chance as 100 minus the rating), the Table 17 fall ladder (rules/wsgfall.h R437: the six bands 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 20 dice, the 1000-foot free-fall rate, the 600-800 severe slope), the tumble rates (rules/wsgtumble.h R438: the 10-foot abrasion granularity, the 100-300 gentle and 300-500 moderate rates), the stop windows (rules/wsgstop.h R439: 50 feet cliff or severe, 75 moderate, 100 gentle), the jump floors (rules/wsgjump.h R448: the 2-foot broad and 1-foot high floors, the 20-foot run, the 1d3 heap at 5 feet), the slippery-surface cadence (rules/wsgslip.h R447: the five-segment run check, the half-rate caution) and the airborne fall chance (rules/wsgfallair.h R461: the zero base, the -200/-150 straps, the -50 proficiency, the -10 saddle and stirrups). The findings: the Table 17 dice are the triangular numbers (increments 2, 3, 4, 5) and the 51-or-more band caps at 20d6 ONE DIE SHORT of the pure sequence value 21; the prose linear 1d6-per-10-feet understates the printed table (3d6 at 20 feet, not 2d6); the cliff/severe stop window of 50 feet is exactly the top of the 41-50 damage band; the gentle stop window equals the gentle tumble rate minimum; the rate ladder is contiguous (100-300, 300-500, 600-800, 1000); and the horizontal slip deals no direct damage while the inclined tumble abrasion kills.
audit_label: R501 WSG movement fall fold audit

banner.provenance: No new book pages: every value is the landed original re-read from its header (wdfFallDice, wdfFreeFallRate, wdtAbrasionPerFt, wdtGentleRateMin, wsfAttemptCliffSevereFt, wcsNonThiefRating, wcsFallBase, wjpStandFloorFt, wslRunCheckSegs, wfaStrapFullBodyPct and kin) and re-pinned on the fold side so the boundary identities compile and ride the mutant battery. The findings: the triangular dice ladder with the cap breaking the sequence at the top; the prose-vs-table tension (the linear formula understates every band past the first); the stop windows pinned to the damage-band top and the tumble-rate minimum; the contiguous rate ladder; and the slip-to-tumble seam between the harmless horizontal fall and the killing inclined tumble.
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: census 425 -> 426; the gap report stays 186 closed / 0 open (closed - no flips this round); the falling chain has no gaps.
banner.title: The WSG MOVEMENT/FALL-CHAIN FOLD, R501: the third seam round after gap closure. The climbing ratings (rules/wsgclimb.h), the Table 17 fall ladder (rules/wsgfall.h), the tumble rates (rules/wsgtumble.h), the stop windows (rules/wsgstop.h), the jump floors (rules/wsgjump.h), the slippery-surface cadence (rules/wsgslip.h) and the airborne fall chance (rules/wsgfallair.h) reconciled as one system: one falling character, one chain, every rate and threshold cross-checked between its headers.

bools.comment: the Table 17 dice are the triangular numbers 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 - each band adds one more die than the previous band added: increments 2, 3, 4, 5.
bools.name: wmvDiceLadderTriangular

bools.comment: the 51-or-more band caps at 20d6 - one die SHORT of the pure triangular sequence value 21; the printed maximum breaks the ladder it completes.
bools.name: wmvCapBreaksSequence

bools.comment: the prose says 1d6 cumulative per 10 feet, but the printed table is steeper than linear at every band past the first - a 20-foot fall is 3d6, not 2d6; the table is the authority.
bools.name: wmvProseVsTableTension

bools.comment: the cliff/severe stop window of 50 feet is exactly the top of the 41-50 damage band - one foot into the open-ended 20d6 band and it is too late to stop.
bools.name: wmvStopWindowBandTop

bools.comment: the gentle stop window of 100 feet equals the gentle tumble rate minimum of 100 feet per round - the attempt must come within the first round of the slowest tumble.
bools.name: wmvGentleWindowEqualsRate

bools.comment: the rate ladder is contiguous and strictly ascending: gentle tumble tops at 300 where moderate begins, moderate tops at 500 below the severe 600, severe tops at 800 below the 1000 free fall.
bools.name: wmvRateLadderContiguous

bools.comment: the fall damage and the tumble abrasion share the same 10-foot granularity - one die per 10 feet beyond the threshold.
bools.name: wmvTenFootGranularity

bools.comment: the horizontal slip deals no direct damage (wslFallNoDirectDamage) while the inclined tumble abrasion kills - the seam between the flat and the slope is the whole difference.
bools.name: wmvSlipHarmlessTumbleDeadly

bools.comment: the climbing fall chance is the complement of the rating: 100 minus 40 leaves the non-thief a 60 percent fall chance.
bools.name: wmvClimbFallIsComplement

bools.comment: the airborne reductions are ordered by security: the full-body strap halves the lower-body strap, the saddle and stirrups each add 10, and the base chance is zero.
bools.name: wmvAirLadderOrdered

applied to the water chapter: one swimmer state flows
through five landed headers - the swimming rates
(rules/wsgswim.h R450), the moving-water hazards
(rules/wsgmwater.h R451), the dive leg (rules/wsgdive.h
R452), the treading economy (rules/wsgtread.h R453) and
the surfacing/breath rules (rules/wsgbreath.h R454).
Pinned as rules/wsgswimfold.h (prefix wmf, 49 inlines:
39 consts + 10 bools, no grids, NO gap flips - the
report stays 186/0). FINDINGS: the vertical rates equal
each other (dive base and surface base both 2 inches) and
are exactly half the horizontal base (20 vs 40 feet); the
Table 24 dive column matches the dive prose exactly (x2
moderate, x3 heavy/severe); the encumbrance paradox (the
moderate speed denominator 2 numerically equals the
moderate dive multiplier 2 - the same weight that
halves speed doubles the sink rate); the forty-foot
agreement (the dive falling-damage threshold equals the
waterfall save threshold - the headers cross-reference
each other); the mercy drift cap equals the
light-current range; the check ladders differ (breath
Con Checks step +2, treading Str Checks step +1); three
distinct endurance economies (rest 3/turn, high speed
1/10, treading 1 point per 2 turns). Honesty fix during
authoring: the treading example (str 6 -> 12 rounds) is
doubled by the Table 24 UNENCUMBERED endurance modifier,
not by the 2-turns-per-point constant - the 2s coincide
but the semantics differ; pinned as wmfEncMultUnenc.
